title: 在動作列設定搜尋所有動作
summary: 動作列設定新增搜尋，可一次找到動作列、更多與隱藏中的動作，直接編輯或調整顯示位置。
highlights: 依動作名稱即時搜尋所有位置，支援內建與自訂動作。
搜尋結果保留編輯與顯示位置操作；清除搜尋即可恢復原分頁與排序。
usage: 開啟設定 → 動作列，在「搜尋動作」輸入名稱。搜尋期間暫停排序，按「清除」即可恢復，不需額外設定。

en.title: Find actions across all toolbar settings
en.summary: Search Toolbar, More and Hidden together, then edit matching actions or change their display location.
highlights: Find built-in and custom actions by name as you type, across all locations.
Edit results and change display locations directly; clear the search to return to your previous tab and reorder actions.
en.usage: Open Settings → Toolbar and enter a name in Search actions. Reordering is paused while searching; select Clear to restore it. No additional setup is required.
